title: sdks: unify auth/retries and streaming ergonomics across python/ts/go + parity/version bumps
author: Aisha Patel
release_notes: Unifies auth, retry, and streaming behaviors across Python, TypeScript, and Go SDKs; ergonomic improvements for streaming handlers; parity fixes and package version bumps. No public API breaking changes; includes migration notes for a couple of auth config keys.
description:
Motivation:
Unify SDK behavior for authentication, retry/backoff, and streaming APIs across Python/TypeScript/Go so that users get consistent semantics and error handling regardless of language. Over time the SDKs diverged (different default retry policies, different streaming callback ergonomics, and some mismatched environment variable names), which makes cross-team integrations and debugging harder.

Summary of changes:
- Normalize auth configuration: accept REDWOOD_API_KEY, support fallback to cloud KMS token path, and align header/metadata behavior across SDKs.
- Standardize retry policy and backoff: default to idempotent-aware retries, unify jitter/backoff calculation and max retry window.
- Streaming ergonomics: provide a consistent streaming event object shape and high-level helper that supports async iterators (py/ts) and channel-based receive (go).
- Parity fixes: bring TypeScript docs and Python examples in line with Go behavior for streaming errors and cancellations.
- Version bumps: bump package versions to collect parity releases (py 1.12.0, ts 2.8.0, go v0.11.0).
- Tests and CI: update unit/e2e tests across SDKs, add a smoke test that exercises streaming reconnect + retry semantics.

Checklist:
- [x] API/behavior design review (ENG-1423)
- [x] Implementations for Python, TypeScript, Go
- [x] Unit tests for auth and retry logic per SDK
- [x] Streaming e2e smoke tests
- [x] Docs updated (quickstarts, migration notes)
- [x] Release notes drafted

Commits (high-level):
- a1f4b2c  Unify auth env var handling and header composition across sdks
- b2d7e5a  Implement common retry policy and expose config knobs
- c3e8f4d  Streaming: add unified event shape and helpers (py/ts/go)
- d4f9160  Parity fixes: align examples and tests, fix edge case on stream cancel
- e5a1b23  Bump SDK package versions and changelogs

Files/areas touched (high level):
- sdk/python/redwood/auth.py (normalized env var parsing + header helper)
- sdk/typescript/src/auth.ts (parity with python semantics)
- sdk/go/auth/auth.go (env handling + token providers)
- sdk/*/retries/* (common backoff calculations and unit tests)
- sdk/*/streaming/* (stream event types, helpers, e2e smoke tests)
- docs/quickstarts/* (migration notes + examples)
- package.json, pyproject.toml, go.mod version bumps

Testing/CI:
- Local unit test suites run for python/ts/go.
- Added streaming smoke test in perf-canary pipeline (non-blocking).
- CI initially failed on TS linting (prettier rule mismatch) and a flaky go test (stream cancel timing). Both were fixed in follow-up commits and CI reran. Final CI status: all checks passed on merge.

Review conversation (high level):
- Liam: requested clarifications on retry window default and whether we should expose maxRetries globally or per-call.
- Aisha: responded that default is conservative (3 retries for idempotent ops) and added per-call override in the design; updated docs.
- Sofia: raised concerns about streaming API ergonomics for Node server-side vs browser; added a compatibility helper and tests.
- Ethan: code review for Go implementation and concurrency primitives; requested a couple of small atomicity fixes which are included.

Migration notes for consumers:
- Minor config key rename: REDWOOD_API_KEY remains supported; prefer REDWOOD_TOKEN_PATH for KMS-based tokens (both supported during deprecation window).
- Retry defaults changed: libraries that relied on previous retry behavior should explicitly configure RetryPolicy to maintain old behavior.

Rollout:
- Gradual rollout for hosted SDK docs and npm/pypi/go proxies. Backwards-compatible by default and feature-flagged in a couple of customers where strict parity was required.

Merge outcome:
- PR was squashed and merged to main on 2026-03-03 after approvals from all reviewers and green CI.

review_comments: Liam Chen: Please document the reasoning for 3 retry default and add config for per-call override.
Aisha Patel: Added per-call override and explanation in docs (see updated quickstart).
Sofia Martinez: In Node, streaming should support both EventEmitter style and async iterator. Added compatibility helper.
Ethan Hughes: Go concurrency nit: use atomic flag for stream cancel to avoid double-close. Fixed.
notes: No customer-facing breaking changes expected; deprecation windows in place for env keys.
Follow-up: monitor streaming error rates in next 2 weeks (perf-canary).
Follow-up: prepare a patch release if any regressions found in dot-releases.
